icons.name: resize-column

motions.description: The scores are plotted. Light: the value triangle is pushed out along its three axes and stops dead on its values, and the three data points flash in turn around the chart (top, right, left). Strong: two readings: the triangle steps out halfway and stops, then out to its full values, and the data points flash bigger. Values never overshoot; the axes never move; the plotted triangle stays.
